name: agentic-harness
description: A plug-and-play catalogue of Claude Code packs: skills, agents, workflows, hooks and mods. Enable only what a project needs.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Always-on base: lean-code rules, and the packs skill that finds and enables the right packs for your problem.

intents: set up the harness for this project

plugins.name: harness-band
plugins.description: Always-on mod: a line above the prompt with the harness packs that are on, context use and session cost, plus the instant /harness command.

plugins.name: ui-pack
plugins.description: UI without the AI look, built on how people scan and decide: use-case layout playbooks, laws of UX, DESIGN.md style, curated shadcn registries, then screenshot, audit, fix.

intents: my UI looks generic or AI-made
need a dashboard or hero section
where should things go on my page
metadata.try: build a dashboard in the Vercel style

plugins.name: motion-pack
plugins.description: Motion design in code: launch videos and reels rendered frame by frame, with a self-critique loop.

metadata.try: make a 20s vertical launch video for <url>

plugins.name: docs-pack
plugins.description: Create, restructure or update a README that explains the project clearly and looks good on GitHub.

intents: make the repo look good on GitHub
metadata.try: rewrite this README so people get it in 10 seconds

plugins.name: deploy-pack
plugins.description: Deployment strategist and DevOps: audits a project, recommends the cheapest fitting stack with costs, then sets up CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environments, rollout and rollback.

intents: Terraform or CDK for my app
how do I roll back a bad deploy
metadata.try: where should I deploy this, cheaply?

plugins.name: council-pack
plugins.description: LLM council made of Claude agents: independent answers, anonymous peer ranking, chairman synthesis.

plugins.name: architect-pack
plugins.description: System and product design partner: requirements, options, Well-Architected pillar review, deployment plan, design artifacts. Also uploadable to claude.ai.

intents: design the architecture for my product
metadata.try: design the architecture for a booking app

plugins.name: glassbox
plugins.description: Open the black box: record why each decision was made, map how the code flows, and quiz yourself before accepting a change.

metadata.try: explain what you just built and quiz me on it
intents: I do not understand the code Claude wrote
quiz me before I accept this change

plugins.name: system-one
plugins.description: Cheap small models for typed judgments (TypeSafe Jev) and extraction or summaries (ScaleDown), so the big model only decides.

metadata.try: summarize this 40 page PDF cheaply before you read it
intents: this file is too big to read
make a cheap yes or no judgment

plugins.name: memory-pack
plugins.description: Project memory as Markdown committed to the repo, so it follows you across machines and cloud sessions. A small index loads at session start.

metadata.try: remember that we deploy from the release branch

plugins.name: research-pack
plugins.description: Deep research across web, GitHub, Reddit, X and YouTube: a parallel workflow with A to E source grading and fact-checking, and a sources tracker you can audit with /sources.

metadata.try: /research-pack:deep how do teams run Postgres on Kubernetes in 2026?
intents: what are people saying about X

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Sweep a codebase with a dynamic workflow: cheap agents scan, stronger agents fix in isolated copies, a verifier keeps only proven changes.

intents: fix this across the whole codebase

plugins.name: test-pack
plugins.description: Write the tests a change needs, find flaky tests, and loop on fixes until the suite is green.

metadata.try: write tests for the change I just made
intents: CI is red, make it green

plugins.name: security-pack
plugins.description: Secret and dependency checks, an OWASP review of a diff, and a guard that asks before dangerous shell commands run.

metadata.try: security review my diff before I push

plugins.name: db-pack
plugins.description: Schema design, safe zero-downtime migrations, and index review for Postgres, MySQL and SQLite.

metadata.try: design the schema for a multi-tenant booking app

plugins.name: observability-pack
plugins.description: Add structured logs, health checks, metrics and error tracking so production problems are visible and debuggable.

metadata.try: add logging and error tracking to this API

plugins.name: ship-pack
plugins.description: Branch, commit, open a PR and write release notes the way this repo wants, following its CLAUDE.md and CONTRIBUTING rules.

metadata.try: commit this and open a PR
intents: what branch name should I use

plugins.name: launch-pack
plugins.description: Turn a finished project into a launch: README polish, a launch video, a blog post and social posts, all from the real code.

intents: write a blog post about my repo

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Upstream: brainstorm, plan, TDD, subagent execution and review methodology.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Upstream: art direction for frontend work, image-to-code, redesign and style skills.

plugins.name: playwright-cli
plugins.description: Upstream: token-efficient browser automation. Needs `npm i -g @playwright/cli`.

plugins.name: web-design-guidelines
plugins.description: Upstream: Vercel's ~100-rule UI audit for accessibility, UX and performance.

plugins.name: session-mem
plugins.description: Upstream: automatic session memory with compression and semantic search in a local database. Local only, so it does not reach cloud sessions.

plugins.name: firecrawl
plugins.description: Upstream: Firecrawl web search, page reading, scraping and research indexes through its hosted MCP server. Needs a Firecrawl account; connect with /mcp.
